en: What if the things that you're chasing.
zh: 如果你一直在追逐的那些东西呢。

en: success, achievements, the perfect person, the perfect job, the perfect location.
zh: 成功、成就、那个完美的人、完美的工作、完美的居住地。

en: aren't really going to bring you joy, aren't really what life is about?
zh: 其实并不会真正给你带来快乐，也并不是真正的人生意义呢？

en: My name is Heidi and in this video I want to share with you what I've learned in 50 years
zh: 我叫Heidi，在这支视频里，我想和你分享我在50年人生里学到的一些东西

en: and losing almost everything to chronic illness.
zh: 以及在慢性病中几乎失去一切之后的体会。

en: I used to think that living was doing, doing, doing.
zh: 我以前一直以为，活着就是不停地做、做、做。

en: and from the moment I got out of bed in the morning
zh: 从我早上起床的那一刻起，

en: till the moment I fell into bed for years, years and years,
zh: 到晚上倒头躺回床上的那一刻，多年来一直如此，

en: I was in constant motion.
zh: 我始终都在不停地运转。

en: I didn't have time to slow down, to contemplate life.
zh: 我没有时间慢下来，去思考人生。

en: to think am I living my story or am someone else's story
zh: 去想，我活的是我自己的人生，还是别人的人生

en: or society's story? And then I got sick, really sick over 10 years.
zh: 还是社会替我写好的人生？后来我病了，病得很重，整整十多年。

en: and lost almost everything I lost my career.
zh: 几乎失去了一切，我失去了我的事业。

en: I lost all the achievements that I had strived so hard to achieve
zh: 我失去了所有那些我曾经拼命努力才得到的成就

en: and I couldn't drive.
zh: 而且我连车都不能开了。

en: I was in bed most of the time.
zh: 大多数时候，我都只能躺在床上。

en: and when all those labels are stripped from you, who are you?
zh: 当那些标签都从你身上被剥离之后，你到底是谁？

en: It was a really dark time for me.
zh: 那对我来说是一段非常黑暗的时期。

en: and it led me on a journey of self-discovery that has been the most unexpected
zh: 但它也带着我踏上了一段自我发现的旅程，这是我人生中最出乎意料的

en: and amazing thing in my life.
zh: 也是最奇妙的一件事。

en: So I want to share with you some things that I've learned through this journey.
zh: 所以我想和你分享一些我在这段旅程中学到的东西。

en: Number one, if your body or your mind is telling you to slow down.
zh: 第一，如果你的身体或你的心告诉你该慢下来了。

en: listen, there were so many, so many opportunities for me to slow down before I got completely leveled
zh: 那就听它的，在我彻底被击垮之前，其实有太多太多次机会让我慢下来

en: but I didn't listen and I kept going.
zh: 但我没有听，我还是一直往前冲。

en: and that's when it took a massive toll.
zh: 结果就是，它最终让我付出了巨大的代价。

en: I believe that you pay, you will pay for what you're living,
zh: 我相信，你会为你正在过的生活付出代价，

en: how you're living. Second is, instead of thinking about what's next, think about what's now.
zh: 为你生活的方式付出代价。第二，与其总想着下一步是什么，不如想想此刻是什么。

en: I was three steps ahead of where the present moment was when I was running,
zh: 以前我一路拼命往前冲的时候，脑子里总是比当下超前了三步，

en: running, running. and what this has taught me, this whole experience has taught me,
zh: 不停地往前赶、往前赶。而这段经历教会我的，整段经历教会我的，

en: is to be in the now because when I'm two events or three events
zh: 就是活在当下，因为当我比现实超前两件事、三件事

en: or three steps ahead, I'm not living in the now.
zh: 或者三步的时候，我就没有活在当下。

en: And also that is where anxiety is, that's where fear is.
zh: 而且，焦虑就在那里，恐惧也在那里。

en: but in the now it's not because so much of my illness
zh: 但在当下，它们并不在那里，因为我的病里有太多部分

en: and I had anxiety about getting worse and what every symptom meant.
zh: 都让我焦虑，担心自己会不会更严重，担心每一个症状到底意味着什么。

en: and all of that was in the future, which hasn't happened.
zh: 而这一切都在未来，可那些都还没有发生。

en: And right now, yes, there's discomfort.
zh: 而此时此刻，是的，确实会有不适。

en: but there's also a lot of other things there too.
zh: 但与此同时，也还有很多别的东西存在。

en: So live for now, be all in for now.
zh: 所以，活在当下，全身心地投入当下。

en: Instead of looking at what you don't have.
zh: 不要总盯着你没有的东西。

en: which is exactly the way that we culturally are conditioned.
zh: 这恰恰是我们的文化一直在训练我们的方式。

en: right, to look at what we don't have so we can strive to get that
zh: 对吧，让我们总去看自己没有什么，这样我们才会拼命去争取那些东西

en: and that's going to bring us X, Y and Z, but it isn't true.
zh: 然后以为那会带给我们这样那样的满足，但其实并不是。

en: Look at what you have now, what you have in this moment.
zh: 看看你现在拥有的，看看这一刻你拥有的东西。

en: I took so much for granted.
zh: 我曾经把太多东西都视作理所当然。

en: When I lost it, I thought, wow, I should have been more grateful in the moment
zh: 等我失去它们的时候，我才想，天哪，我当时真该更懂得在那个当下心怀感恩

en: and now I am grateful for so much.
zh: 而现在，我对很多很多事都心怀感激。

en: I have a really close friend who's 90, maybe you've seen some of our videos with Marvin
zh: 我有一位非常亲近的朋友，他90岁了，你可能在我们和Marvin一起拍的一些视频里见过他

en: and he lives in assisted living.
zh: 他住在辅助生活机构里。

en: and he tells me about the people with Parkinson's where just getting a meal
zh: 他会跟我说起那些患有帕金森病的人，对他们来说，哪怕只是把一顿饭

en: or a fork to their mouth is so huge and it's exhausting
zh: 或者把叉子送到嘴边，都是一件非常艰难的大事，而且非常耗人

en: and it's so hard.
zh: 真的特别难。

en: When's the last time you thought about eating, being present for a meal
zh: 你上一次认真想过吃饭这件事是什么时候，真正专注地吃一顿饭

en: and thinking about the gift of being able to pick up food with your fork
zh: 并且意识到，自己能够用叉子把食物叉起来

en: and bring it to your mouth with ease?
zh: 再轻松地送到嘴边，这其实是一种馈赠？

en: You don't think about what we have until it's gone, but have gratitude.
zh: 人总是等到失去之后，才会想到自己曾经拥有过什么，所以要学会感恩。

en: Look at the abundance that we all have, no matter what your situation is.
zh: 看看我们每个人所拥有的丰盛吧，不管你现在的处境是什么。

en: I couldn't see anything but my illnesses, they were so consuming.
zh: 以前我的眼里除了疾病什么都看不见，它们几乎吞没了我。

en: I didn't realize that I had so much to be grateful for all around me.
zh: 我没有意识到，在我周围，其实有那么多值得感恩的东西。

en: until I started to kind of go through this journey and I had a roof over my head,
zh: 直到我开始走过这段旅程，我才发现，我有一个能遮风挡雨的家，

en: I had healthy food, I had a wonderful cozy bed and a partner who cares
zh: 我有健康的食物，我有一张温暖舒服的床，还有一个关心我的伴侣

en: and a dog who's amazing.
zh: 还有一只特别棒的狗。

en: There's a lot, but you got to slow down to realize it,
zh: 其实有很多很多，只是你得先慢下来，才会意识到，

en: to look around, to look inside and see what's there.
zh: 去看看四周，去看看内心，看看那里到底有什么。

en: Don't wait until it's the right time.
zh: 不要等到所谓合适的时机。

en: or the right job or the right partner or the right situation.
zh: 或者等到合适的工作、合适的伴侣、合适的处境。

en: Do the thing now.
zh: 现在就去做那件事。

en: If you get that stirring inside of you, listen to it.
zh: 如果你内心有那种蠢蠢欲动的感觉，就听它的。

en: it's there for a reason.
zh: 它在那里出现，是有原因的。

en: I thought I had to wait until I was healthy to experience joy
zh: 我曾经以为，必须等到我彻底健康了，我才能感受到快乐

en: and the reality is I'm healthier.
zh: 而现实是，我现在的确更健康了。

en: but I may never be rid of all the things that I'm dealing with.
zh: 但我也许永远都无法彻底摆脱我正在面对的所有问题。

en: That doesn't mean I can't enjoy life now, I can't get out now,
zh: 但这并不意味着我现在就不能享受生活，我现在就不能出门，

en: I can't move, I can't do things, I can.
zh: 我不能行动，我不能做事情，其实我可以。

en: So often we wait for the perfect whatever to do the thing
zh: 我们太常常在等一个所谓完美的条件，才肯去做那件事

en: and then it passes us by and that becomes a habit and we keep waiting,
zh: 结果它就那样从我们身边溜走了，而这又会变成一种习惯，于是我们继续等待，

en: we let that one go, we let that one go, we contemplate,
zh: 一次次放过机会，一次次放过机会，不停地权衡，

en: we overthink, we overanalyze, we get analysis paralysis.
zh: 不停地想太多、分析太多，最后陷入 分析瘫痪。

en: Make listening to that feeling, that sensation, that stirring and acting upon it.
zh: 把倾听那种感觉、那种感受、那股内在的冲动，并且立刻行动起来，

en: Make that the habit.
zh: 变成一种习惯。

en: That's what life is about.
zh: 这才是人生的意义所在。

en: You're going to experience so much more.
zh: 你会因此经历到更多更多。

en: Your time and attention are your two most valuable resources.
zh: 你的时间和注意力，是你最宝贵的两种资源。

en: Use them wisely. Everything is vying for our attention these days.
zh: 请明智地使用它们。如今，一切都在争夺我们的注意力。

en: Wow, it is crazy.
zh: 天哪，真的太疯狂了。

en: But that's our currency, that's our resource.
zh: 但那就是我们的货币，那就是我们的资源。

en: What we pay attention to determines how we feel, what we think about,
zh: 我们把注意力放在哪里，会决定我们的感受、我们在想什么，

en: what we believe, and how we make choices.
zh: 我们相信什么，以及我们会如何做选择。

en: Do the things that you're paying attention to and you're investing your time in.
zh: 那些你正在关注的事、那些你正在投入时间的事，

en: Make you feel better about life and about yourself and about possibilities?
zh: 会让你对生活、对自己、对可能性有更好的感受吗？

en: Or do they make you feel worse?
zh: 还是会让你感觉更糟？

en: Or do they move you further away from where you want to go?
zh: 还是会把你推得离自己真正想去的地方更远？

en: Remember, your attention and your time are valuable.
zh: 记住，你的注意力和时间都非常珍贵。

en: I spent so much time worrying.
zh: 我曾经花了太多时间在担心上。

en: and being consumed by all the negative things that it was hard for me to see a positive path forward.
zh: 被各种负面的东西吞没，以至于我很难看见前方有一条积极的路。

en: But when I started directing my attention.
zh: 但当我开始把我的注意力转向

en: toward healing, toward the things that build me up.
zh: 疗愈，转向那些能滋养我的东西。

en: and away from the things that trigger me or make me feel less than,
zh: 并且远离那些会触发我、或者让我觉得自己不够好的人和事时，

en: wow, that's pretty amazing.
zh: 哇，那真的很神奇。

en: Be brave. Step outside your comfort zone.
zh: 勇敢一点。走出你的舒适区。

en: I do in some areas of my life and other areas have been more difficult.
zh: 我在生活的某些方面做到了，而另一些方面则更难一些。

en: But I have pushed myself so far out of my comfort zone.
zh: 但我确实已经把自己推出舒适区很远很远了。

en: Like doing a video like this would not have been the old me.
zh: 比如拍这样一支视频，放在以前的我身上，是根本不会做的。

en: But I feel so passionate about what I want to share with the world
zh: 但我真的非常想把我想和这个世界分享的东西说出来

en: and what I've learned because it's changed my life in so many amazing ways.
zh: 把我学到的东西说出来，因为它以那么多美好的方式改变了我的人生。

en: And if I can feel this way, everybody else can feel this way.
zh: 如果我能有这样的感受，其他人也一定可以有这样的感受。

en: And I think it's what the world needs right now, this connection.
zh: 而且我觉得，这正是这个世界现在最需要的东西，这种连接。

en: It doesn't have to be a big thing, just a nudge, just a little challenge.
zh: 它不一定非得是什么大事，只要一点点推动，只要一个小小的挑战。

en: And it makes you feel so good about yourself when you do it.
zh: 而当你真的去做的时候，你会对自己感觉特别好。

en: Just the effort, just the act.
zh: 哪怕只是去努力，哪怕只是去行动。

en: Don't worry about the outcome.
zh: 不要担心结果。

en: It's just the effort.
zh: 重要的就是那份努力。

en: For the people in your life that you appreciate.
zh: 对于你生命里那些你真心珍惜的人。

en: tell them, tell them you appreciate them.
zh: 告诉他们，告诉他们你很珍惜他们。

en: and what you appreciate about them.
zh: 也告诉他们，你具体珍惜他们的哪些地方。

en: It makes them feel really good and it makes you feel really good.
zh: 这会让他们感觉特别好，也会让你自己感觉特别好。

en: And the more, the better.
zh: 而且越多越好。

en: And last, I'm going to close with you are enough and you were born enough.
zh: 最后，我想用一句话来结尾：你本来就足够好，而且你生来就足够好。

en: And I didn't feel that for my first 50 years.
zh: 而在我人生最初的50年里，我从来没有真正这样觉得。

en: And let me tell you the truth.
zh: 让我告诉你一个事实。

en: Just saying it. Okay, I'm enough now.
zh: 光是嘴上说一句 好吧，我现在已经足够好了。

en: After 50 years of believing otherwise, it doesn't stick.
zh: 在你已经相信相反的东西50年之后，这句话是扎不下来的。

en: It doesn't feel authentic.
zh: 它不会让你觉得那是真的。

en: The way to feel enough is to be kind to yourself.
zh: 真正让你感到自己足够好的方式，是善待自己。

en: to give yourself compassion every single day.
zh: 是每天都给自己一点同理与慈悲。

en: And to believe in yourself, to accept all of you, and to keep feeding that enoughness every day.
zh: 是相信自己，接纳完整的自己，并且每天都持续滋养这种 我已经足够好 的感觉。

en: It's like a living organism where you have to nurture and cultivate it
zh: 它就像一个活的生命体，你必须去照料它、培育它

en: and pull the weeds of negative thinking.
zh: 还要拔掉那些负面思维的杂草。

en: and your internal critic, where you think.
zh: 以及你内在那个总在批评你的声音，那个让你觉得。

en: okay, I may be a little bit different than everybody else.
zh: 好吧，我可能和其他人有一点不一样。

en: That's okay. I love that.
zh: 那也没关系。我喜欢这样。

en: I want to be different.
zh: 我就是想与众不同。

en: I don't want to be the herd.
zh: 我不想成为随大流的人。

en: I want to be me.
zh: 我想做我自己。

en: And I believe in me.
zh: 而且我相信我自己。

en: So do something kind for yourself every single day.
zh: 所以，每天都为自己做一件善意的小事。

en: And while you're at it, do something kind for someone else.
zh: 同时，也为别人做一件善意的小事。

en: I hope these have been helpful for you.
zh: 希望这些内容对你有帮助。

en: They've changed my life in every way and my relationships.
zh: 它们从方方面面改变了我的人生，也改变了我的关系。

en: Thanks so much for watching.
zh: 非常感谢你的观看。

en: I'll see you in the next video Have a great day.
zh: 我们下个视频见，祝你今天过得愉快。
